name: dsh-plugin-manager
description: Local plugin manager for this dsh-plugins monorepo: install this ONE bundle in the web profile and the new Settings > 本地插件 panel manages every dsh-* sibling plugin under the repo root (activate / disable / remove / one-click migration from the legacy per-plugin layout). Host half scans the repo, keeps the activation list as stable-id rows in the profile's cordis.patch.yml (applied live by DSH's patch HMR), auto-installs missing devDependencies via pnpm, and serves /__dsh-plugin-manager/* HTTP endpoints; browser half registers the 'local-plugins' settings section.
